text: The NVHRM offers national coverage with a probabilistic multi-hazard scope, modular editions, and expert elicitation. It aligns with the Sendai Framework and integrates directly with national insurance frameworks, providing high market coverage. The model is consistent with other national hazard models and includes a foundational national ashfall model. It employs a four-step probabilistic hazard methodology and is coupled with EQC's deterministic/probabilistic loss modeling for comprehensive risk management.

metadata.solution_name: National Volcanic Hazard and Risk Model (NVHRM)
